question: The trains Rajdhani Express and Garib Rath Express run in the same direction with speeds of 101 km/hr and 65 km/hr, respectively, and their lengths are same. What is the length of Rajdhani Express if it completely crosses Garib Rath Express in 66 seconds?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction ⇒ relative speed = 101 − 65 = 36 km/hr

Convert speed ⇒ 36 × (5/18) = 10 m/s

Time = 66 sec ⇒ distance = 10 × 66 = 660 m

Total length = sum of both trains = 660 m

Lengths are equal ⇒ each = 660 ÷ 2 = 330 m

**∴ Answer = 330 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Rajdhani = 101 km/hr

Speed of Garib Rath = 65 km/hr

Time = 66 seconds

Lengths are equal

**Formula used:**

Time = Total length ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed (same direction) = 101 − 65 = 36 km/hr

⇒ Convert to m/s = 36 × 5/18 = 10 m/s

⇒ Let length of each train = L

⇒ Total length = L + L = 2L

⇒ 66 = (2L) ÷ 10

⇒ 2L = 660

⇒ L = 330 m

**∴ The correct answer is 330 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ subtract speeds

Train Crossing Rule

Total distance = sum of lengths

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18

Key Insight

Equal lengths simplify calculation
